scope: SQOCH-39 through SQOCH-44 and approved-prototype fidelity correction

automated.responsive_regressions: Four browser failures exposed two genuine regressions: unbroken subject overflow at 360/320 and recovery controls below the first viewport. Source fixes preserve full text, one recovery action, and all existing E2E assertions. Final full run passes.

mutations.scope: 42 curated semantic mutations, including all historical 33. Not exhaustive AST mutation coverage.

live.note: Live API/SMTP acceptance precedes the final frontend-only fidelity port; backend contracts and delivery source are unchanged by that port.

preservation.limits: Read-only local verification. No demo reset/load or external delivery. Source checks preserve existing files; accumulated changes are intentionally retained.

visual.method: CUA with CDP PNG capture limited to the painted 720px viewport; ordinary scrolling for controls. Reference toolbar is excluded from product comparisons. Saved files inspected.
visual.fixture: Separate SQLite and test MockTransport on loopback port8014. No SMTP worker. Initial/clarification/prepared/preview use reference ceramics data. Progress uses synthetic 6sent/1failed/1unknown. Overview reads the preserved working database.
legitimate_differences: Dynamic dates, recipient details and operational error states
One safe recovery action before detailed mobile counters
Server-derived generic clarification copy and additional request recovery
visual.rejected: Older 900/1000-height captures, 732x700 panel and full-page captures contain repeated or blank off-surface content. They are retained as rejected acquisition attempts, not final proof.
visual.limits: Scoped visual correspondence and browser regression checks, not exhaustive WCAG certification or full-app pixel identity. Temporary visual helper does not test production Origin middleware.
